notes.formal_exam: Binding glossary decision (chunk 02): Formal Exam = „Offizielle Prüfung“ (practice_set = „Training zur offiziellen Prüfung“); „Prüfungsmodus“ breaks the link between the chip and the set name.
notes.select_exam_types: Glossary (de chunk 03): „exam types“ = Prüfungsarten everywhere; benefit_all_exams / paywall_subtitle_exam already say „Prüfungsarten“, the setup screen used „Rechenarten“.
notes.benefit_all_levels: Plural of Level is „Level“ (no -s) in chunks 01/02 and the glossary (chunk 06); „in allen Levels“ also forces an awkward dative, so „für alle Level“.
notes.paywall_subtitle_generic: Plural „Level“, not „Levels“ (app-wide decision, chunks 01/02 use „alle Level“).
notes.freemium_body_pick: Plural „Level“, not „Levels“ (chunk 01 billing_issue_message: „alle Level, Spiele und Berichte“).
notes.purchase_benefit_2: „Perlenrichtung“ was rejected in the chunk 01 review as an unnatural compound (display_bead_direction = „Richtungspfeile anzeigen“); the feature is the direction arrows on the beads, so name them the same way.
notes.paywall_subtitle_tables: Mixed times-table practice is „Gemischtes Üben“ in the glossary (de chunk 06); „Training“ is reserved for the Abacus Practice mode.
notes.paywall_percent_off: Standalone label on its own row of the plan card (PaywallKit / PurchasePlanCard): a German label starts with a capital, as paywall_save_vs_monthly already does („Ca. …“); the bracketed _extra variant may stay lowercase.
notes.paywall_intro_first_days: Fills „%1$s, danach <price>“ on a one-line (maxLines = 1) plan-card text; „In den ersten 3 Tagen, danach …“ is 60 % longer than the English, the nominal „Erste 3 Tage, danach 4,99 € / Monat“ reads like a normal German offer line and fits.
notes.paywall_intro_first_weeks: Same one-line length fix as paywall_intro_first_days.
notes.paywall_intro_first_months: Same one-line length fix as paywall_intro_first_days.
notes.paywall_intro_first_years: Same one-line length fix as paywall_intro_first_days.
